definitions.explanation: A feeling of resentment toward someone because of their advantages, possessions, or relationships.

examples.japanese: {嫉妬|しっと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{燃|も}えて→燃える：02312_moeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嫉妬|しっと}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I felt jealous of her success.

examples.japanese: {嫉妬深|しっとぶか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、{嫉妬|しっと}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: When I heard my friend bought a new car, I couldn't help feeling jealous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{他|ほか}→他：04129_hoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}して→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、{嫉妬|しっと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I felt jealous seeing him talking to another woman.

notes:
{嫉妬|しっと} covers both jealousy (resentment toward a rival) and envy (wanting what others have). It is a suru verb: {嫉妬|しっと}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {嫉妬|しっと}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel jealous
- {嫉妬|しっと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel jealousy
- {嫉妬|しっと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{燃|も}える→燃える：02312_moeru⟧: to burn with jealousy
- {嫉妬深|しっとぶか}い: jealous by nature (adjective)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やきもち→焼き餅：20151_yakimochi⟧: jealousy (colloquial, especially romantic — ⟦やきもち→焼き餅：20151_yakimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧)
- ⟦{羨望|せんぼう}→羨望：05751_senbou⟧: envy (literary, less negative)
- ⟦うらやましい→羨ましい：02336_urayamashii⟧: envious (adjective, lighter tone)

USAGE:
{嫉妬|しっと} is stronger and more negative than ⟦{羨望|せんぼう}→羨望：05751_senbou⟧ or ⟦うらやましい→羨ましい：02336_urayamashii⟧. It often implies romantic jealousy but is also common for professional or social envy. The kanji are complex and rarely written by hand.
